req.title: Player creation persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall commit newly created players to the players table so subsequent GET requests return them.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the persistence of player creation in the database, ensuring that the system behaves correctly under normal, boundary, and erroneous conditions. The tests cover positive, negative, and boundary scenarios to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_player_success
preconditions: The database is initialized with predefined players.
No player exists with squad number 27.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new player with squad number 27.
expected: The response contains the correct player data.
The Location header points to the new player's resource.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

new_player = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27
assert response.headers["Location"] == "/players/squadnumber/27"

tests.name: test_create_player_duplicate_squad_number
preconditions: The database is initialized with predefined players.
A player already exists with squad number 1.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new player with squad number 1.
expected: The response contains a conflict error message.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

duplicate_player = {
    "firstName": "Duplicate",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=duplicate_player)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()["detail"]
